# plot_xsecs

`#!python plot_xsecs(**kwargs)`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Plot the photo cross sections of the catalogue's reactions.

Forwards to `plot_xsecs` with all reactions as a
flat list.  Reactions without cross-section data are skipped.  Accepts
every `plot_xsecs` keyword (`grid`, `processes`, `bands`,
`style`, `palette`, `save`, `show` ...).

**Returns**

_tuple[matplotlib.figure.Figure, numpy.ndarray] or None_
